notes.title: Achieving more.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We're currently updating a few of our older games to keep them fresh, and we've recently turned our attention to Fungoids. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L7NYbipEP3A&t=8s

This time we've added 17 Steam Achievements, and in Alpha mode, you'll find, 18 ship upgrades as well as a few additional challanges, tweaks and gameplay improvements.

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Fungoids takes control.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

As part of our commitment to upgrade Fungoids with new features, we're pleased to announce that we've added keybinding so you can now choose your own keys to suit your playing style.

Keep an eye out for more additions to alpha mode later this month.

As always, please feel free to comment.

The JimJamsGames team.

notes.title: Fungoids - Steam Version - V1 goes live.
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We're pleased to annouce the launch of the first in our range of very retro games on Steam. 

Fungoids takes many classic game themes from the 1980's and blends them together in a simple yet addictive bomb 'em up.

We aim to keep developing the Alpha mode for Fungoids, adding new features over the months and hopefully years to come.

If you love true retro gaming, this is the game for you.

Enjoy,

The JimJamsGames team.
